title: Standard Library, Foundation, and Text Processing
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of standard library, foundation, and text processing in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 11: Standard Library, Foundation, and Text Processing. Lessons in order: Swift Standard Library Overview; Strings and Unicode; String Operations; String Formatting and Localization; Tuples and Destructuring; Common Standard Library Protocols; Sequence and Collection Protocols; Iteration, Lazy Evaluation, and Algorithms; Foundation Essentials; Date and Time Handling; Regular Expressions and Text Matching; Data Formatting and Serialization Foundations.
